$comment: Copy to routes.json and edit. Destinations the Router agent may pick. 'file' is relative to OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH. 'section' is the H2 heading tasks get appended under (created if missing). The Router only ever sees these ids and descriptions. 'owner_context' is one line about whose mailbox this is - it goes into the Extractor and Router system prompts so they judge relevance the way you would.
owner_context: a busy professional juggling several client accounts, a new-business pipeline and internal admin

routes.description: Acme Corp account: platform rollout, org design, integration workstreams, people topics (Alex, Jordan, Sam).
Northwind engagement and its carve-out from the parent group: transition services, day-one checklist, vendor sourcing, branding, advisor workstreams (Robin, Casey).
New business and deal flow: outreach, intros, NDAs, first screens, market scans.
Internal admin: expenses, time reporting, scheduling, travel, IT, HR, compliance, recurring reporting.
Non-work items: home, family, home server, private purchases.
Fallback when no other route clearly fits. Prefer this over guessing.
